newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Washington, N.C.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Washington, N.C.

text.p: General Obligation Sanitary Sewer Bonds, Series 1997
Sealed bids will be received by the Local Government Commission of North Carolina at its office in the Albemarle Building, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North
Carolina 27603-1385 until 11 o'clock A.M., North Carolina Time,

such bids to be opened in public at said time and place on said day, for the purchase of the following bonds of the City of Washington, North Carolina, dated June 1, 1997 and maturing (subject to the right of prior redemption)
The bonds will be delivered on or about June 24, 1997 against payment therefor in Federal Reserve Funds at The Depository Trust Company.

Copies of the Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to the bonds may be obtained from the Local Government Commission (919-733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form.
